appDescription: A long stage from the Lilla Laxemar cabin to the remote Hällveberg cabin. The official route leaves the old pasture and powerline corridor near Simpevarp, passes Ströms by, Gammal-Näs, Stålglo, Ny-Näs, Södra Uvö, Uthammar and Bredviken/Bredviksberget, then continues through Figeholm nature reserve before crossing the Figeholm-Fårbo road and E22 near Sippetorp. Near the end the route gives access toward Fårbosjön, crosses Virån and reaches Hällveberg. The route geometry is strong and continuous, but access logistics need care: Figeholm/Fårbo services are side-detours, and Hällveberg has no car road to the cabin.

dogs.summary: Figeholm reserve requires leashed dogs/pets. General Swedish rule context also applies: March 1-August 20 dogs must be kept from running loose where wildlife exists and year-round they must not pursue wildlife. Use leash near grazing animals.

grazingAndLivestock.summary: Official route text starts through old pasture/hagmark. Döderhult reminds hikers to close gates. No current active-livestock notice found; model as general conduct/safety note rather than confirmed active grazing.

hunting.summary: No section-specific hunting closure found. Naturkartan English page reportedly showed a seasonal elk-hunting notice for October 8-January 31 while Swedish page did not show the same notice; on 2026-04-29 this period was not active. Treat as seasonal/general safety caveat.

fire.summary: Oskarshamn page said no current municipal fire ban on 2026-04-29, but fire bans change quickly. Apply stricter local rules: no outdoor fires at both endpoint cabins, and no fires in Figeholm reserve except designated places.

roadSafety.summary: Official Etapp 7 text identifies crossings/road use at kustvägen, the Figeholm-Fårbo road and E22 after Sippetorp. Hällveberg has no direct car road access, so pickup must be via E22.

waterSafety.summary: Hällveberg well should be treated/boiled. Lilla Laxemar water is seasonal/currentness-sensitive. Fårbosjön is a swimming-water/badplats, not drinking water; current bathing-water sample status should be rechecked in season.
